scripts.dev: npm run dev:clean && concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:clean: sh -c 'PIDS=$(lsof -tiTCP:4000 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null; lsof -tiTCP:4001 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$PIDS" ]; then echo "Stopping stale API processes: $PIDS"; echo "$PIDS" | xargs -r kill -9; fi'
